sam.sales: ACME POC: seeing ValidationError + occasional truncated JSON when using function_call + mode=json on batched payloads. Can eng help triage?

kai.eng: Can you paste a sanitized request + one failing assistant response? Which model variant?

sam.sales: Using gptx-4o-hosted. Request (redacted): {"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"ingest batch"}], "functions": [{"name":"record_event","parameters": {"type":"object", "properties": {"id": {"type":"string"}, "meta": {"type":"object"}}, "required": ["id"], "additionalProperties": false}}], "function_call": "auto", "mode": "json" }

sam.sales: Failing assistant response they saw: {"name":"record_event","arguments":"{\"id\":\"evt-9\",\"meta\":\"tags:[]\"}"} 

kai.eng: That is double-serialized arguments (string instead of object). Also we see truncated streams in traces which cause JSONParseError. Nora can you check rate-limit traces?

nora.sre: Confirmed spike at 11:22 where x-rate-limit-remaining=0 and several upstream ECONNRESETs. Logs: [11:22:13] upstream 429; stream closed. That likely caused partial chunks.

lee.se: Quick unblock options: 1) client quick-fix: JSON.parse(arguments) before validation; 2) ops temporary rate bump for the org while they run batches; 3) short-lived canary pre-parser behind tenant flag that attempts to un-stringify arguments and strip helper keys.

sam.sales: ACME wants fastest unblock — which is quickest?

nora.sre: Short-term: I can bump their org bucket from 200->400 qps for 2 hours and increase per-route burst. That should reduce mid-stream 429s. No billing changes for this courtesy window; sales to confirm if longer needed.

kai.eng: I'll prepare a tiny canary that: if typeof arguments === 'string' try JSON.parse(arguments); if arguments is primitive, wrap into {id: String(arguments)} for known functions. Metric emitted: poc_args_parsed. Will keep behind tenant flag `poc.lenient_parse` and redact logs.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for `poc/lenient-parse` -> canary at 2026-03-21T20:05:00Z.

nora.sre: Rate bump applied for tenant acme_poc for 2 hours. Monitoring dashboards: org.acme_poc.errors and ingress.stream_aborts.

sam.sales: ACME validated client patch + canary: truncations stopped and schema failures dropped significantly; one residual case where model emitted helper `__hint` keys was handled by the parser stripping unknown keys.

kai.eng: Long-term recommendation: either relax their `meta` schema (allow additionalProperties) or enumerate expected fields. We'll offer the opt-in lenient tenant flag for the remainder of the POC while they iterate.

sam.sales: Thanks team — I'll send this summary to ACME and ask for any remaining raw assistant responses if they see further failures. :white_check_mark:
